title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 2.00 (quiet) at 02:59 UTC on 19 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 19 日 02:59 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 2.00（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest complete-minute estimated Kp = 2.00 (label 2Z). Last-180-sample maximum is 2.33 (at 01:43 UTC); published-window maximum is 2.33 (at 01:43 UTC). Hours through 20:00 UTC have rolled out of the public window. Residual 21:00 UTC slice: peak 1.33 / 1P (57 samples, closed at 1.33 / 1P). Completed bins 22:00–01:00 UTC closed at 1.67 / 2.00 / 0.00 / 2.33 respectively. 02:00 UTC bin now complete (60 samples; peak 2.33 / 2P, closed at 2.00 / 2Z). estimated_kp remains below 5.0.
summary.zh: 最新完整分鐘估計 Kp = 2.00（標籤 2Z）。近 180 筆最大 2.33（01:43 UTC）；公開窗最大 2.33（01:43 UTC）。至 20:00 UTC 已滾出公開窗。殘留 21:00 UTC 切片：峰值 1.33／1P（57 筆，收在 1.33／1P）。22:00–01:00 UTC 已結束（分別收在 1.67／2.00／0.00／2.33）。02:00 UTC 已結束（60 筆、峰值 2.33／2P、收在 2.00／2Z）。estimated_kp 仍低於 5.0。

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest complete minute (not a lone new-hour 0.00 placeholder). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: estimated_kp is a near-real-time estimate, not the final observatory Kp. The public file is a rolling ~6-hour window (~355 samples), so earlier hours fall out of the file.

title.en: A magnitude 5.5 earthquake occurred in the Kermadec Islands region on 18 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 18 日，克馬德克群島海域發生規模 5.5 地震。

summary.en: USGS M4.5+ day feed: mww 5.5, depth about 94 km. No new events listed this hour. Current day-feed maximum is mww 5.5 (us7000tigd).
summary.zh: USGS M4.5+ 一日饋送：mww 5.5，深度約 94 公里。本小時無新增上架。一日饋送目前最大為 mww 5.5（us7000tigd）。

evidence.method: Added from the public USGS all-day M4.5+ GeoJSON feed when the event first appeared in the rolling 24-hour window.
evidence.limitations: Magnitudes and locations can be revised by USGS. The day feed only retains recent M4.5+ events.
